name: Employee
description: Store employee profile information and manager assignments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Employee's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager for approval workflows

fields.name: role
fields.description: Employee's job role or designation

fields.name: isHRAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if employee has HR administrator privileges

fields.name: hireDate
fields.description: Date when the employee was hired

constraints.email: Must be a valid email format
constraints.managerId: Must reference an existing employee ID or be null for top-level employees

name: LeavePolicy
description: Defines leave types, entitlements, and organizational leave rules for employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave policy

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (annual, sick, personal, maternity, paternity, etc.)

fields.name: entitlementDays
fields.description: Number of days entitled per year or period

fields.name: accrualRate
fields.description: Rate at which leave accrues (days per month)

fields.name: carryOverAllowed
fields.description: Whether unused leave can be carried over to next period

fields.name: maxCarryOverDays
fields.description: Maximum number of days that can be carried over

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this leave policy is currently active

constraints.entitlementDays: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.accrualRate: Must be greater than 0 if specified

name: LeaveBalance
description: Track current leave balances for each employee by leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this leave balance

fields.name: leavePolicyId
fields.description: Reference to the leave policy type (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: availableBalance
fields.description: Current available leave balance in days or hours

fields.name: usedBalance
fields.description: Total leave already used in the current period

fields.name: pendingBalance
fields.description: Leave amount currently pending approval

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last balance update

relationships.description: Each leave balance belongs to one employee
Each leave balance is associated with one leave policy type

constraints.uniqueEmployeePolicy: An employee can have only one balance record per leave policy type
constraints.nonNegativeBalances: availableBalance, usedBalance, and pendingBalance must be non-negative values

name: LeaveRequest
description: Store leave request details, status, and approval history

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee submitting the request

fields.name: leaveType
fields.description: Type of leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Employee's reason for requesting leave

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)

fields.name: approvalHistory
fields.description: Array of approval records with approver, action, timestamp, and comments

constraints.dateValidation: endDate must be greater than or equal to startDate
